# github-members fixtures

Who may read the repository, as GitHub reports it. Used by the ACL mapping and by `listTeamMembers`.

- `collaborators.json` collaborators `octocat` (admin) and `hubot` (push), with `octocat` repeated once to prove de-duplication
- `teams.json` teams with access to the repository: `Justice League` (pull) and `Docs` (push), with slug and privacy
- `justice-league.json` members of the `justice-league` team: `octocat` and `hubot`
- `docs.json` members of the `docs` team: `octocat`
